title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The versions table catches up with the other three
summary: The previous release claimed the catalog navigation and the unused dependency scan could no longer drift apart. That held for three tables out of four.

highlights.title: A version reaches the build files that read it
highlights.description: Ctrl+click on a key of the versions table now finds libs.versions.key and findVersion, on top of the catalog entries that pin their version on it.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: Shift+F12 on a key, or on any reference to it, lists the declaration first and then every use.
Shift+F12 had no test of its own until now, on any table.
Thirteen more timing budgets in the test suite are judged on the fastest of three runs, so a busy machine no longer stops a release.
